scope: Read-only independent review of the prewritten R1 adversarial harness against CODE-GIT-KERNEL-R1, CODE-GIT-KERNEL-CLARIFICATIONS-R2 and the frozen fixture. No candidate implementation was imported or run.

findings.title: Success-output assertion omits the proof-bearing fields
findings.observation: assert_success_shape checks only target path/outcome/reason and target key order. It does not compare object_records, consumed_oids, budget, walk edges, stopped_at, blob records, nested key order, or primitive field values against the fixture/contract. A candidate can therefore return incorrect closure, walk, missing-name_hex, or blob identity data and still pass all closure checks.
contract_refs: CODE-GIT-KERNEL-R1.md exact success result and stopped_at
findings.required_successor_change: Deep-compare every closed result record, budget, consumed list, walk/stopped_at/blob shape and key order against independently derived expected facts; explicitly assert missing stopped_at name_hex.

findings.title: Candidate scope check is tautological and does not bind the handed-off snapshot
findings.observation: actual_changed is constructed from ALLOWED_PATHS itself and compared with the same set, so extra changed paths are never detected. The check also does not validate candidate_snapshot_sha256, reviewed_head/tree shape or source bytes against a frozen baseline.
findings.required_successor_change: Require exact handoff hash/head/tree fields, validate the three allowed files only against the handoff snapshot/manifest, and reject candidate roots with any additional changed/untracked paths using a non-mutating inventory.

findings.title: Helper validation-order and detail contracts are under-tested
findings.observation: Only five successful helper vectors per format are exercised. No helper bad object_format/object_type/body type ordering, exact instance pointers, exact limit details, empty-body boundary, or helper refusal surface is checked.
findings.required_successor_change: Add independent helper type/enum/cap vectors for frame_git_object and git_object_ids, hash traps for each precedence edge, and exact code/details assertions without source echo.

findings.title: Error details and fixed-message constraints are not verified
findings.observation: expect_error checks exception class, code, exit_code and that details is a dict only. It does not enforce the required bounded instance_pointer/context fields, fixed non-source-echoing message, or exact context for each error code.
findings.required_successor_change: Assert exact allowed detail keys/values per case, bounded pointers, fixed message text, and absence of body/path/name repr leakage.

findings.title: Commit/tree grammar mutation coverage is materially incomplete
findings.observation: The harness covers four tree mutations and two commit mutations only. It omits CR/NUL/TAB header cases, malformed continuation, tree/parent continuation rules, header byte and line caps, duplicate tree/parent headers, invalid names and ordering variants beyond one unsorted case.
findings.required_successor_change: Add hash-valid mutations for each contract grammar/refusal category with independently recomputed records and exact byte_offset/reason checks.

findings.title: Closure assertions do not verify walk, unsafe outcomes, or consumed-set accounting
findings.observation: The closure path calls assert_success_shape, which ignores walk/stopped_at/blob/object_records/consumed_oids/budget. Missing, symlink, gitlink, executable refusal, directory and non-directory cases therefore do not prove the required edge or non-consumption semantics.
contract_refs: CODE-GIT-KERNEL-R1.md verification order, walking and exact success result
findings.required_successor_change: Derive expected walk/stopped_at/blob/consumed/budget independently from fixture tree facts and compare every field in every fixture case.

findings.title: Profile immutability/order checks are incomplete
findings.observation: The harness checks only type name, dict equality and one item assignment. It does not assert exact MappingProxyType identity, insertion order, deletion/update/pop/clear refusal, or that a lowered per-call copy leaves the profile and later calls unchanged.
findings.required_successor_change: Check type(profile) is types.MappingProxyType, list(profile) exact order, all mutation operations, and post-lowered-call profile/cap invariance.

findings.title: Purity/static import checks leave observable gaps
findings.observation: AST checks catch only direct import statements; dynamic __import__/importlib/eval/exec paths and import-time side effects are not audited. Runtime guards omit environment/resource-loader access, and input ownership is not checked after the refusal path.
contract_refs: CODE-GIT-KERNEL-R1.md implementation boundary and pure API
findings.required_successor_change: Expand static forbidden-call scan or run import/purity probes in an isolated module namespace; guard relevant resource/env entry points and assert all input snapshots after both success and refusal.

findings.title: Handoff/fixture preflight does not validate all exact bindings
findings.observation: The handoff checks required keys and path set but not exact head/tree/hash formats, candidate snapshot identity, allowed-path list order/duplicates, fixture schema/content counts, or frozen baseline relation.
findings.required_successor_change: Validate exact widths/patterns, manifest hash and baseline relation before importing candidate; preserve a preflight record bound to the handoff head/tree.

next_action: After Builder stops and supplies exact handoff, run a successor harness that closes HARNESS-R1-001/002/003/004/005/006; do not run historical R1 harness as final acceptance.
